area: project configuration: declare the headless mechanics contract the checker asked for

find.report_claim: aikit check shooter reported 'Game detected but .aikit/project.json has no mechanics contract; declare mechanics.core and mechanics.test for a headless AI-testable core'
find.live_evidence: project.json had mechanics_required false and no mechanics block, even though the project is built around a headless deterministic core (shooter/sim.py) with seeded Sim instances and 537 passing tests
find.consumer_evidence: without the contract an AI agent reading project.json cannot tell which files are the testable core or which command exercises them without a GL context, so it must read the whole suite to find out

read: scripts/project_gates.py gate ordering and the duplicate-command warning
shooter/tests to separate headless suites from engine/server ones
killed: pointing mechanics.test at the same command as gates.test: project_gates explicitly warns that this runs the suite twice
declaring the whole tests directory: it includes engine, server, capture and export suites that need a GL context or loopback sockets, so it would not be a headless core test
leaving mechanics_required false: the project genuinely is a headless-testable game, so the flag should state that rather than leave it ambiguous
analyze.survivor: declare core as the sim and bot modules, and mechanics.test as the five headless suites that need no engine, server or capture harness

fix.shooter: .aikit/project.json sets mechanics_required true and declares mechanics.core as [shooter/sim.py, shooter/bot.py] with mechanics.test running test_keystone_mechanics, test_hurt_shake, test_los_broadphase, test_death_camera_path and test_campaign_camera_path

shooter.mechanics_command: 43 passed in 5.86s standalone; 8.3s as a gate
shooter.gates: 5/5 (hygiene, guidelines, secrets, test, mechanics); the checker reports the mechanics gate as new and running, and the mechanics-contract advisory is gone
shooter.tests: 537 passed, 2 xfailed in the full suite
